liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **She Belongs To Me** (3 reviews): Fast-paced version of She Belongs To Me, though Jerry flubs the lyrics; She Belongs To Me is smokin' on the audience recording [27][33][36]
- **Alabama Getaway** (1 review): Alabama Getaway into Jack Straw made an energetic, brilliant opening pairing [27]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Garcia plays riffs in Jack Straw that the reviewer had never heard him rip before [28]
- **Lost Sailor** (1 review): Lost Sailor into Saint of Circumstance into Deal closes the first set with raw rock energy [27]
- **Crazy Fingers** (1 review): Segue into Crazy Fingers starts like a train wreck at double speed, then resolves nicely [34]
- The first set is singled out as especially strong [26]

## Setlist highlights

- **She Belongs To Me**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 10 archived performances [37]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-04-04.149449.sbd.miller.clugston.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 149 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd1985-04-04.sbd.tetzeli-orig-fix-11704.33816.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 147 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [2]. Said about its sound: Matching levels caused some clipping on the drums during Space, where snares are hit hard [2]
- **gd1985-04-04.140939.unknown.bryant.miller.clugston.flac1644**: audience recording; 23 songs; 148 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1985-04-04.178656.akg451.neumann.u87.blend.bradt.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 151 min [5]
- **gd85-04-04.oade-schoeps.sacks.23848.sbeok.flacf**: source not stated; 22 songs; 153 min; rated 4.19/5 by 27 [11]. Said about its sound: Praises the audience recording as well done [34]
- **gd85-04-04.sbd.willy.11704.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 141 min; rated 3.33/5 by 9 [21]. Said about its sound: This soundboard transfer sounds weaker than most 1985 soundboards; Reviewer finds the soundboard's sound quality horrible; Soundboard sound is pretty bad [26][29][32]

## Around the show

- Garcia's throat sounded froggy, yet the band played strongly throughout [28]
- The Oade Schoeps audience source is livelier and more energetic than the soundboard [31]
- Reviewer prefers the available audience recording to the soundboard [32]
- Oade apparently used no limiter, while Amy probably did, which is audible in the difference [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-04-04.149449.sbd.miller.clugston.flac16**: source: Unknown > Dat (16/44.1) [1]. Also: Probably a cassette master, one or two generations down; the sets may come from different sources; First-set channels were corrected and second-set pitch changed; Charlie Miller upgraded it from a hard drive [1]
- **gd1985-04-04.sbd.tetzeli-orig-fix-11704.33816.shnf**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: fix of shnid = 11704 [2]. Also: The missing Space was patched in from Doug Oade's audience recording into the soundboard [2]
- **gd1985-04-04.140939.unknown.bryant.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Robert Bryant; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Source Info: Robert Bryant's Master Audience Cassettes; unknown mics > Sony TC-D5M; Transfer Info: Master Cassettes (Nakamichi CR-7A)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF… [4]. Also: A Sennheiser 421 source supplies a 36-second patch in Drums [4]
- **gd1985-04-04.178656.akg451.neumann.u87.blend.bradt.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bill Bradt; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Bill Bradt's Master Audience Cassettes: AKG 451 shotguns (Left, Right) + Neumann U-87 (Center) blend > unknown mixer > Sony D5M (Maxell MX-90) [5]
- **gd85-04-04.oade-schoeps.sacks.23848.sbeok.flacf**: taped by Oade Brothers; transferred by Doug Oade - Darren Sacks; source: Schoeps CMC441s (90deg, 17cm) > Oade M118 > Oade mod SONY PCM-F1 [11]
- **gd85-04-04.sbd.willy.11704.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>HiFi Video (Lighting crew)>MC>CDR [21]

claims.text: This soundboard transfer sounds weaker than most 1985 soundboards
The first set is singled out as especially strong
Alabama Getaway into Jack Straw made an energetic, brilliant opening pairing
Fast-paced version of She Belongs To Me, though Jerry flubs the lyrics
Lost Sailor into Saint of Circumstance into Deal closes the first set with raw rock energy
Garcia's throat sounded froggy, yet the band played strongly throughout
Garcia plays riffs in Jack Straw that the reviewer had never heard him rip before
Reviewer finds the soundboard's sound quality horrible
The Oade Schoeps audience source is livelier and more energetic than the soundboard
Soundboard sound is pretty bad
Reviewer prefers the available audience recording to the soundboard
She Belongs To Me is smokin' on the audience recording
Segue into Crazy Fingers starts like a train wreck at double speed, then resolves nicely
Praises the audience recording as well done
She Belongs To Me is stellar
Probably a cassette master, one or two generations down; the sets may come from different sources
First-set channels were corrected and second-set pitch changed; Charlie Miller upgraded it from a hard drive
The missing Space was patched in from Doug Oade's audience recording into the soundboard
Matching levels caused some clipping on the drums during Space, where snares are hit hard
Oade apparently used no limiter, while Amy probably did, which is audible in the difference
Master audience cassette from Robert Bryant, transferred by Charlie Miller
A Sennheiser 421 source supplies a 36-second patch in Drums
Master cassette came from Bill Bradt and Kathy Weir Bradt; Charlie Miller transferred and coordinated
